what: Text is split into words, and each word, starting transparent·scale 0·75% below, bounces into place in .8s power2.out, with the order shuffled randomly and delayed .05s each — words do not settle left to right but form all at once across the text line. Emphasis bands in the text (data-fx-part="bar") spreads from left to right in 1.2s at the same time, flipping the text above it to the background color. It receives fx:play (from the start)·fx:reset (hidden)·fx:show (instantly fully visible) so it replays each time a section enters in a page-turn panel

options.delay: Start delay (s), default 0 — the original staggers per line, e.g. title .15 and body .3
options.bar-delay: Accent band delay (seconds), same as the default delay
options.on: If event, hides right after attaching and runs only when fx:play is received (screen-transition version)
options.start: (If present) ScrollTrigger start — once when visible
options.[data-fx-part=word]: Pre-split words (if present, the text is not split)
options.[data-fx-part=highlight]: Text group to lay an accent band under — inside [data-fx-part=bar] one empty span
options.fx:played: Event fired by the element when done

use: Your intro line here. Line to highlight

from.where: index.html data-sd-words text in every section (title .15 · intro .3 · folder text 0 to .3 · contact lines .3 to .45) — original playSondavenReveal (.8s power2.out, shuffled order × .05, band scaleX 1.2s)
